title: SpongeBob Points at Teen
description: A young man with curly brown hair lies in bed holding a blue smartphone, looking toward the camera with a neutral expression. A large cartoon SpongeBob SquarePants is overlaid on the right, pointing at the man's forehead with his extended arm.
prompt: A realistic photo of a curly-haired young man with blue eyes lying in bed on pineapple-patterned pillows, wearing a white t-shirt with a red square, holding a blue smartphone and looking at the viewer. A large classic 2D cartoon SpongeBob SquarePants stands to the right pointing directly at the man's head with his index finger, inside a messy bedroom with a wooden headboard covered in stickers including a pineapple and a red 'PEE-AAAAA' label, a yellow lamp visible, dated text overlay in the corner
